words.definition: to go from one place to another, often to a different country.
words.example: We love to travel in summer.

words.definition: a journey to a place and back.
words.example: We took a trip to the mountains.

words.definition: the act of traveling from one place to another.
words.example: The journey took six hours by train.

words.definition: a person who visits a place for pleasure.
words.example: Many tourists visit the old city every year.

words.definition: an official document you need to travel to another country.
words.example: Don't forget your passport at the airport.

words.definition: the bags and cases you take with you when you travel.
words.example: We packed our luggage the night before.

words.definition: a building where you pay to sleep when you travel.
words.example: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.

words.definition: to arrange to have a room, ticket, or seat before you arrive.
words.example: I booked our flights online.

words.definition: a piece of paper that shows you have paid to travel or enter somewhere.
words.example: She bought a ticket for the train.

words.definition: in or to a foreign country.
words.example: They went abroad for their holiday.

words.definition: the place where someone is going.
words.example: Paris was our final destination.

words.definition: a case with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel.
words.example: He packed his suitcase quickly.

words.definition: a drawing that shows where places are.
words.example: We used a map to find the museum.

words.definition: a person who shows tourists around a place.
words.example: Our guide told us about the castle's history.

words.definition: visiting interesting places as a tourist.
words.example: We spent the day sightseeing in the old town.

words.definition: a small item you buy to remember a place you visited.
words.example: I bought a souvenir from the market.

words.definition: an area of sand or stones next to the sea.
words.example: We relaxed on the beach all afternoon.

words.definition: an exciting or unusual experience.
words.example: Climbing the mountain was a great adventure.

words.definition: the way of life, customs, and art of a group of people.
words.example: We learned about the local culture.

words.definition: the money used in a particular country.
words.example: We changed our money into the local currency.

text: Last summer, my sister and I decided to travel abroad for the first time. We planned a two-week trip to Italy. First, we had to check our passports and book our flights and hotel online. Before we left, we packed our suitcases carefully and put all our luggage in the car. The journey to the airport took about an hour, and we showed our tickets at the gate. When we arrived, we felt so excited! Our destination was a small town near the sea, with a beautiful beach and old streets full of history. Every day, we went sightseeing with a friendly local guide who told us stories about the culture and the town's past. We also used a paper map to explore on our own because it felt like a real adventure. In the evenings, we visited the market to buy souvenirs for our family. We had to change our money into the local currency before we could buy anything. By the end of the trip, we were tired but very happy. It was one of the best adventures of our lives, and we already want to travel again next year.
